rationale: Per-epoch noise resampling (new (phantom, low-dose-noise) pair every epoch, same 400 phantoms; effective 3200 train pairs). Headroom 0.5807 -> 0.5768 (-0.67%), val_ssim 0.3099 -> 0.2947 (-4.9%). Worse. Hypothesis: the dual-domain N2I training_step already does its own per-batch noise split (Wagner 2022 Noise2Inverse), so adding per-epoch noise variation breaks that internal noise structure rather than augmenting it. Discard; reverting solver to iter-25 baseline.
advice_for_others: Per-epoch noise resampling does NOT compose with the dual-domain Noise2Inverse loss — the inner split already provides the diversity the model needs; adding outer-loop noise variation hurts. If you want more (phantom, noise) pairs, train_n is the safer knob.
